oracle.ref: PR #1022 (feat); fix evidence: 07/10/2026: seven default questions must change the site on WordPress, Joomla and EmDash for every gallery template (issue #1013 phases 2 and 3, plan tasks/plan-ten-logo-favicon.md).
oracle.invariant: Every run exits 0 with 0 failures and 0 skipped tests. Joomla T3: every template style takes the light or dark logo its profile names (JA Smallbiz four styles, JA Mood 'Home Dark' the dark one), every other param kept; the favicon goes through template.siteSettings other_faviconFile; plugin 0.22.0 writes the logo and skips the favicon as plugin too old. Joomla T4: one template.siteSettings set with site_logo and site_logo_dark plus one content.contract apply on the footer slot; file names are new on every run and never a template file; apply.revert of every recorded id puts the site back. EmDash: the tool runs with --brand-only, the three files and the apply id; settings.logo, settings.favicon and the chrome entry's logo_dark land on the site and --revert takes all of it back; a picture the tool could not write is a skip with its reason, and nothing fails the build. EmDash pages: an unticked id is unpublished in every written language and its menu items are removed, --revert brings both back; the home page is never hidden. EmDash tone: the tone reaches the copy prompt as the voice beside the description; no tone leaves the prompt as it was.
